# MTDI Studio

> MTDI 5.0 (Microprocessing Technological Diagnostic Intelligence): a pure-Python framework that turns anything producing numbers (sensors, firmware, software, networks, security logs) into channels and runs five pillars over them: Validation Chamber, Environmental Intelligence, NVTRA, I³ and Aether. One project.json per project; runs on a Raspberry Pi.

AI assistants: start with docs/AI.md and follow it step by step. Do not describe MTDI from memory.

## Start here

- [AI playbook](docs/AI.md): the procedure to apply MTDI to any project
- [Integration guide](INTEGRATING.md): step by step, for people and agents
- [Rules for agents](AGENTS.md)
- [Manifest reference](docs/MANIFEST.md) and [JSON Schema](docs/schema/project.schema.json)
- [Line protocol](firmware/PROTOCOL.md): what firmware and probes print
